voiceover: It worked yesterday. You swear you didn't change anything. Now it's broken. Something changed, and git remembers what. Run git log to see recent commits, or git diff to see exactly what's different. Still lost? Git bisect splits your history in half, again and again, until it finds the exact commit that broke it. You don't have to guess. Send this to whoever says nothing changed.
